run_tpu_training_with_xla_spawn: run TPU distributed training by spawning multiple processes with xla_spawn.py specifying num_cores and training script
parse_xla_spawn_arguments: parse command line arguments for xla_spawn including num_cores, training_script, and remaining training script arguments
spawn_xla_multiprocessing_processes: spawn xla multiprocessing processes using xmp.spawn to launch the training module's _mp_fn function across TPU cores
import_training_script_as_module: import a training script file as a Python module by resolving its path and importing by stem name
patch_sys_argv_for_training_script: patch sys.argv to pass the training script path and its arguments to the spawned XLA processes
